title: Rigorix Audit Envelope v2
description: DRAFT v0 — grounded in rigorix-oss engine/src/audit/domain/envelope.rs (2026-09-06). NOT yet authoritative: completion (delta map vs enterprise audit_ingestion model) is contract-sync milestone 1. Additive fields may be absent in pre-feature envelopes.

template_id.description: Template that generated the execution plan.

planning_hash.description: Hash of the planning prompt — replay reproducibility.

repository.description: Repository the execution ran against, e.g. my-org/my-repo.

author.description: User or bot that triggered the execution.

identity.description: Attributed human identity (ADR-012). REDACTED summary — never the raw token.

model_version.description: LLM model used for planning, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-20250514.

events.description: Ordered execution events (node events incl. sequence_rule_matched, tool_executed...).

scoring_results.description: Scored-evaluation node results keyed by node_id.

signature.description: HMAC signature over the envelope body — integrity verification.

evidence_degraded.description: True = produced WITHOUT HMAC (explicit unsigned marker, GAP-M-12). Distinguishes intentionally-unsigned from tampered.

approval_events.description: Signed approval decisions in approval order (ADR-011 R3).

scope_violations.description: Post-execution scope violations — non-blocking evidence (ADR-011 R5).

sequence_policy_findings.description: Sequence-policy decisions recorded during the run (R6): matched rules, promoted steps, dispatch-boundary denies. Redacted summaries.

decision_context.description: Reference + summary of the decision context shown to the approver (field present in OSS; shape TBD in delta map).

subject.description: Human's unique identifier at the IdP.

source.description: How identity was established (degradation marker preserved).

event_type.description: Machine-readable type, e.g. task_completed, tool_executed, sequence_rule_matched.

payload.description: Event-specific details: per-node output, tool usage, budget warnings, errors...

approvalRecordRef.description: Signed approval decision (ADR-011). Exact shape TBD in delta map (approver_id / authority / decision_context / binding evidence).

scopeViolationRef.description: Non-blocking scope violation (ADR-011 R5). Shape TBD.

sequencePolicyFindingRef.description: Redacted sequence-policy finding (R6): rule id, decision (promote/deny), matched history. Full payloads opt-in, never leave the local store.
